title: Apparatus and method of personalized federated learning based on partial parameters sharing

pse.problem: Inefficient communication due to large amount of information in conventional federated learning and difficulty in optimizing performance for regional data with different characteristics
pse.solution_function: Personalized federated learning by sharing only some parameters of an artificial neural network model and updating the shared parameters based on external devices to improve both communication efficiency and local data optimization
pse.solution_structure: Electronic device with one or more processors, a communication circuit, and memory. The local model is an artificial neural network model divided into a first parameter set (corresponding to global parameters) and a second parameter set (corresponding to local parameters). External device generates updated 1-1 parameter sets based on multiple electronic devices' global parameter sets.
pse.solution_implementation: Learning local model using local data, transmitting first parameter set to external device, receiving updated 1-1 parameter set, changing first parameter set, learning local model with updated 1-1 parameter set. Global parameter set is fixed during training and only the local parameter set is updated.
pse.effect: Improved communication efficiency due to reduced information volume and optimized performance for regional data through personalization
